## Appearance

George Moore strikingly resembles his cousin, [Dick Moore](../character/dick.md). He shares the same distinct facial feature of having one blue eye and one hazel eye.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 31 THE TRUTH MAKES FREE P28](../source/v04-c31.md#nw-v04-c31-p0028), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012)_

## History

At seventeen years old, George Moore spent about a month visiting his Uncle Abner in [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds). Before sailing on the [Four Sisters](../codex/tech.md#four-sisters), he was engaged to a girl in his home town. When his cousin [Dick](../character/dick.md) contracted yellow fever in Cuba, George stayed behind to nurse him while the ship sailed on without them.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P6](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 32 MISS CORNELIA DISCUSSES THE AFFAIR P12](../source/v04-c32.md#nw-v04-c32-p0012), [v4 CHAPTER 36 BEAUTY FOR ASHES P12](../source/v04-c36.md#nw-v04-c36-p0012)_
